name: Domestika creative courses homepage by domestika.org
description: A commerce-led education homepage combines a dark utility navigation with a vivid orange urgency banner and a blue promotional hero. Below the hero, the page becomes highly scannable: four-column course cards repeat a tight image, metadata, discount, and teal purchase-button pattern, then shift into teacher discovery, a sparse benefits grid, and a text-heavy SEO footer. Orange is reserved for promotion and primary calls to action, while teal handles repeated buying actions against a mostly white, lightly bordered canvas.
